name: Singapore Wanderland
desc:
Welcome to Singapore Wanderland, a fantastic garden paradise inspired by Singapore and its many surprises.
 
The Endless Summer Obby is here! Help find all the otters and explore the beautiful waterparks and beaches Singapore has to offer!
 
LIKE THE GAME FOR MORE FREE EXCLUSIVE UGC REWARDS!
 
Leap across giant flowers to reach the top for an amazing view of Garden Galaxis
 
Roleplay with friends and go on a scavenger hunt to find items unique to Singapore in Finders' Isle
 
Race in quirky go-karts surrounded by lush greenery in Jungle Jiffy, all while helping restore the magic in Merlie's garden! Do well, and you'll even be the proud owner of a golden Durian Kart. Good Luck!
